Class KittyKeyboardSupport

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.terminal.KittyKeyboardSupport
public final class KittyKeyboardSupport extends Object
Utility class for Kitty keyboard protocol support (progressive keyboard enhancements).

The Kitty keyboard protocol allows applications to progressively opt into richer, unambiguous keyboard input reporting while safely managing terminal modes via push and pop stack controls.

Escape sequences:

  • Query flags: CSI ? u
  • Query response: CSI ? <flags> u
  • Push flags: CSI > <flags> u
  • Pop flags: CSI < [count] u

  • Method Details

    • query

      public static int query(Backend backend, int timeoutMs) throws IOException
      Queries the terminal for Kitty keyboard protocol support.

      Sends the CSI ? u query sequence and parses the CSI ? <flags> u response. If the terminal does not respond within the timeout, -1 is returned.

      Parameters:
      backend - the terminal backend
      timeoutMs - timeout in milliseconds to wait for response
      Returns:
      the reported flags bitmask, or -1 if unsupported or timed out
      Throws:
      IOException - if an I/O error occurs
